methodology.baseline: Retained source-supported corrected baseline admissions, not a current-company census or verified tenancy. V7 corrects specific location/status fields only; CordenPharma admission is preserved without an independent eligibility review. Basel Orbis V6 classification remains unchanged.
methodology.research: Research counts are selected company/site observation assignment records, not unique or incremental companies. Source records may duplicate baseline entities and recur across locations; attached research sites remain retained even when not additional primary assignments. Institutional references are separate. No automatic company or ambiguous parent-alias merge.
methodology.primaryArea: Each baseline company and each selected research assignment record is assigned once per hub. Reviewed Adial current Glen Allen site and exact S38 address witness precede its unchecked Charlottesville import; unrelated primary assignments retain their previous reported-HQ/precision/stable-city selector. Supported signed/planned site is a non-operating fallback. Additional observations remain retained; not a new headquarters/eligibility census.
methodology.priority: Preserved V5 baseline analyst-priority model only; A/B/C are analyst assumptions, not credit. U and combined tier totals count assignment records, including overlapping research observations. Imported tiers excluded.
methodology.cash: Verified exact cash and cash equivalents only; numeric USD millions; period end 2025-11-04 or later; latest retained period per reporting entity; one allocation per hub; companywide reporting-entity context, not local capital or demand. Cash and investments excluded.
methodology.events: Dated retained physical actions in 2025-2026; planned/completed/unknown status preserved. No financing or clinical headline converted to footprint action.
methodology.nonadditivity: Company-region profiles and reporting-entity cash overlap across hubs; hub totals are not additive.
methodology.addressSites: Supported current address-matched sites are counted at their actual retained area, separately from single primary company assignments. Planned sites are excluded.
methodology.typedPlans: Typed plan records count only retained sites explicitly typed planned, planned_not_commissioned, or lease_signed_opening_not_confirmed. Separate planned/construction action evidence is not exhaustively tallied here. Zero typed plan records does not mean no planning actions.
methodology.entityScope: Baseline profile IDs include retained operating legal entities and brands/affiliates; not unique consolidated parents, independent private firms or independent borrowers. Each profile ID assigned once per hub; physical sites remain in their own geography. Parent/reporting-entity cash allocated once, never imputed to an affiliate. No BI local employee aggregate or new consolidated group census is inferred.
methodology.orbisAssociation: Orbis Allschwil association is operator-reported; current site function and company-specific address remain unverified and research-only. Known Epalinges headquarters does not prove absence of an Allschwil association; no closure or nonpresence finding is inferred.

biotech-beach.geography: Core: San Diego County, Los Angeles County and Ventura County including Thousand Oaks. Explicit extension: Orange County, a contiguous Southern California life-science corridor used to capture evidenced Orange County headquarters; extension records are labeled in coverage notes and each company gap. This does not assert all companies in any county are included.
biotech-beach.decisionRead: Known actions include Carlsbad manufacturing and Torrey Pines shared-lab openings, research-center construction in San Diego and Thousand Oaks, and a scheduled Sorrento Mesa relocation. These distinct actions do not establish regional net absorption.
reviewGaps: No sixth physical-space action is established by the scoped retained evidence. Terray's Monrovia lease citation dates to June 24, 2022 and is outside the review period.

Lilly remains a retained research-layer company record, not a new baseline admission. Its specific San Diego opening is now supported by a re-opened issuer release; the census and site records are unchanged.
Artiva's program discontinuation and workforce cuts do not establish a San Diego lease exit or site closure. M&A ownership changes are not treated as net growth without footprint evidence.
Amgen's event date is the verified September 2, 2025 announcement. The October 31 primary story confirms an earlier groundbreaking but does not disclose its exact day or facility area.
Calidi's primary filing confirms the signed relocation lease and scheduled commencement, not completed physical occupancy. Its new premises area is not a net absorption measure.

Retained regional notes mention a Los Angeles manufacturing closure, but this supplied company evidence has no associated company/source identity for a linked closure card. Orange County retained records do not establish a qualifying space change.

No eligible internal JLL company-action evidence was present in the retained company source records. Internal update-matrix aggregate figures and supplied PDF aggregates were not used. Global parent investment and workforce totals were not converted to local physical demand.

genetown.decisionRead: Known 2025-2026 actions include a Kendall Square R&D opening, Alewife and Seaport leases, a Cambridge Crossing renewal and a Watertown-to-Northbridge manufacturing transfer. These distinct footprint actions do not measure net regional absorption.
reviewGaps: No sixth sufficiently dated physical-space action was established in the bounded retained-source review. No market census, aggregate demand figure or forecast was inferred.
No Genetown internal JLL physical-action source was present in the retained evidence. Basel-only internal material was not used as Massachusetts evidence.
Exact lease execution and move-in dates for Lila Sciences and Lilly were not disclosed by the opened reports. Their publication dates are source dates, not invented event dates.

Sanofi's extension is supported by the readable CoStar excerpt and retained local report, not a reviewed lease amendment. The exact execution date, revised expiry and incremental area remain unconfirmed.
EyePoint's 2025 technology transfer does not establish completed relocation, closure of Watertown, commercial DURAVYU approval or new regional floor area.

Vericel's retained 2026 filing confirms completed Burlington premises and office use while manufacturing awaits validation, but does not establish a 2025-2026 opening or completed manufacturing move. It was not added as another dated action.

Global-parent investments outside Massachusetts, clinical-program changes, job cuts and ownership transfers were not translated into local square footage or assumed site closures. Supplied research aggregates and analyst assumptions were excluded.

signals.text: Accuray reports 9,000 sq ft of Santa Clara office space subleased to a third party as of July 1, 2026. Its filing still lists Sunnyvale and Santa Clara leases; this is not a site closure.

signals.title: Foster City technical center breaks ground
signals.text: Gilead broke ground on a 180,000 sq ft technical development and manufacturing center at its Foster City HQ. Construction started, not an opened facility.

biotech-bay.geography: Independent analytical boundary: San Francisco, San Mateo, Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, and Santa Clara counties. Core is San Francisco, San Mateo, and Alameda counties. Extensions are Santa Clara, Contra Costa, and Marin counties to capture the Peninsula/Silicon Valley, Concord, and Novato corridors referenced by the BioSpace description of Menlo Park, Palo Alto, and surrounding Bay Area counties. No Oregon, Nevada, or other Northern California counties are included.
biotech-bay.decisionRead: Foster City construction contrasts with a Santa Clara sublease, while BioAge's Emeryville move replaces a Richmond lease. These known actions do not establish regional net growth.
reviewGaps: Three supported actions were retained, not six. Other retained financing, clinical, approval, address-only and global-parent records did not establish additional dated local physical-space actions in this bounded review.
No Biotech Bay-specific internal JLL physical-space source was retained in the input. Basel internal extracts were not applied to Bay Area sites.
Gilead's retained announcement supports construction commencement, not an opening or completion date. Its nationwide investment and jobs figures were excluded from local space quantities.

BioAge's February 25, 2025 event date is lease commencement and facility control, not a verified move-in day. Occupancy is confirmed by the March 24, 2026 filing; the former Richmond area and a net footprint change are not established here.

Accuray's retained not_active site labels conflict with its reopened filing's leased-facility description. The supported Santa Clara action is a sublease, not closure; July 1, 2026 is the reported as-of date, not a verified signing date.

Omnicell's retained not_active Milpitas label does not support a closure card. Its reopened 2025 Form 10-K lists the Milpitas facility as leased: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/926326/000092632626000006/omcl-20251231.htm. No dated closure was established.

Original company IDs and source IDs are preserved. All selected companies remain baseline records; supplied research observations were not promoted into baseline evidence. No census, regional totals or net absorption were calculated.

basel.decisionRead: Known actions span Basel, Allschwil and Bubendorf: NBE opened an R&D center, BD established a HORTUS workspace, and Bachem commissioned Building K. ALL remains planned for 2027, not completed or occupied supply.
reviewGaps: No additional retained 2025-2026 local physical-space actions met the support threshold. Financing, approvals, clinical milestones and BeOne's legal redomiciliation were not treated as space demand.

No supported local sublease or site-closure action was identified. Global parent events outside Basel's defined physical-site boundary were excluded; cross-border presence alone does not establish a new action.

NBE and BD openings do not establish net absorption or the amount of space surrendered elsewhere. BD's occupied area and exact opening day, and Building K's area and exact commissioning day, remain undisclosed.

ALL's retained 2025 brochure has conflicting 2026/2027 milestones; current public operator evidence supports early 2027. No exact announcement date is established, and no opening or occupancy is asserted. Its internal source date derives from the filename, not an on-page publication date; only visibility metadata is retained here.

Signals retain baseline company or institution-reference identities without census changes or research-layer reclassification. The Main Campus identifier is an institution reference, not a new company. Undated public pages carry retrieval dates only, not inferred publication dates.

pharm-country.decisionRead: Known actions include planned manufacturing and assembly buildouts in Upper Merion and Philadelphia, plus a Somerset lab addition. Ardena's Somerset acquisition changes the operator of existing space, not the regional footprint; announced buildouts are not confirmed completed capacity.
reviewGaps: The retained local evidence supports fewer than six distinct 2025-2026 physical actions. No supported closure, sublease or relocation was identified; financing, approvals and workforce changes were not used as substitutes.
GSK Marietta construction began in October 2024. Its September 2025 announcement is historical project context, not a new 2025-2026 construction start; it is excluded from the action cards.
GSK's September 2025 source planned Upper Merion construction in 2026. The October 2026 Pennsylvania announcement now specifies a 2027 start; completion and net additional SF are not established.

PCI's April 2026 release anticipated phased Philadelphia and Rockford buildouts over the following six months, but it does not establish Philadelphia completion, local SF or a Philadelphia-only investment amount. US and European spending and shared capacity figures are excluded.

Ardena's announced Somerset lab targeted Q3 2025 operations. The reopened retained facilities directory lists Somerset bioanalysis but does not establish the specific lab's opening date, completion or additional leased footprint; planned status is retained.
Selected actions span New Jersey and Pennsylvania. Retained evidence does not support additional qualifying cards for Connecticut, New York or Rhode Island without researching new company events.

No Pharm Country internal JLL action source was present in the retained evidence. Basel internal extracts concern another region and were not repurposed. Baseline companies remain baseline; imported research observations and analyst assumptions are not promoted to physical evidence.

Each baseline company is assigned once per hub; research assignments are company/site observation records, not unique or incremental companies. Entities may recur across layers and locations.
A/B/C/U totals count assignment records. No ambiguous parent aliases were merged.

Typed plan records count only retained sites explicitly typed planned, planned_not_commissioned, or lease_signed_opening_not_confirmed. Separate planned/construction action evidence is not exhaustively tallied here. Zero typed plan records does not mean no planning actions.

Baseline profile IDs include retained operating legal entities and brands/affiliates; not unique consolidated parents, independent private firms or independent borrowers. Each profile ID assigned once per hub; physical sites remain in their own geography. Parent/reporting-entity cash allocated once, never imputed to an affiliate. No BI local employee aggregate or new consolidated group census is inferred.

Washington/Washington DC and Wilmington/Wilmington DE are exact comparison aliases. Rockville city physical-site component is shown separately and nested within the wider Rockville / I-270 comparison family; neither row is a formal boundary. Do not add a parent-family subtotal to its component counts.
biocapital.geography: State and federal-district boundary exactly follows BioSpace’s stated BioCapital geography. The working spatial envelope covers the full named states and District rather than imposing an unsupported county restriction. Core activity observed in this evidence set is Maryland and the District, with Delaware and Virginia site records explicitly retained as BioSpace-defined extensions.
biocapital.decisionRead: Known actions include a Baltimore lab-office opening, announced Frederick and Gaithersburg construction, and Rockville manufacturing operator changes. The acquisitions preserve existing facilities; the announced Maryland expansion is not completed capacity.
reviewGaps: Fewer than six actions retained. Static site presence, historical building area, financing, approvals and global parent events without a supported local space action were not used to fill cards.
Virginia, Delaware and Washington, D.C. remain gaps in this action shortlist; no qualifying 2025-2026 space action was verified there in this bounded review.

bio-nc.geography: Full State of North Carolina. The regional name explicitly pairs Research Triangle Park with North Carolina, while the map uses a state-level U.S. hotbed label. Triangle-specific concentration is discussed separately from statewide manufacturing sites.
bio-nc.decisionRead: Known actions include a Durham opening, a Morrisville manufacturing lease, and construction or expansion plans in Durham, Holly Springs and Wilson. These differ in delivery status; announced capacity and investment do not establish occupied floor-area growth.
reviewGaps: No internal JLL source was retained for these North Carolina actions. Public local primary evidence was used; unrelated internal Basel extracts were not imported.

Genentech and Johnson & Johnson retain research-layer company identities. Reopened project citations support these actions but do not promote their underlying records into the baseline or change census counts.

Completion or occupied area is not established for the selected planned projects. Liquidia's 2026 occupancy target remains unconfirmed by the reviewed sources; Biogen and Genentech disclose no incremental floor area in these releases.

The retained Novartis April 1, 2026 event date lacked support in its undated site page. The dated company release supports a December 11, 2025 hub groundbreaking; 14TW area is kept separate from hub-wide area.

The retained Johnson & Johnson trade article conflates construction of the earlier Wilson campus with the additional facility. EDPNC distinguishes the two; no exact investment amount, floor area or completion date is assigned to the additional project.

Cellectis's September 2026 program exit and organizational realignment do not explicitly establish a Raleigh facility closure or lease exit. No supported closure, sublease or relocation was selected from the reviewed 2025-2026 evidence.

Selected actions are not a complete statewide activity inventory. Older announcements, approvals, financing, global parent events without local support, ownership transfers and supplied aggregate figures were not treated as new physical demand.

biomidwest.geography: Eight whole states named on the current BioSpace BioMidwest reference page. State outlines independently reproduced from the U.S. Census Bureau 2024 Cartographic Boundary File, not from sponsor map placement.
biomidwest.decisionRead: Known actions show a Lebanon manufacturing opening, Kankakee construction, a planned New Albany facility, and a reported Blue Ash headquarters relocation. These are site-specific changes, not evidence of region-wide net absorption.
reviewGaps: The bounded retained-source review supports fewer than six footprint cards. No internal JLL source is retained in this region's evidence file; no unrelated internal Basel material was used.

Catalent's July 2025 Madison announcement and Evonik's July 2026 Lafayette announcement describe equipment investment or modernization at existing plants, not demonstrated additional floor area, so they are excluded from footprint actions.

Resilience's relocation is reported completed in an August 2026 source, but its exact event date and headquarters area are not stated. The existing West Chester plant area is not incremental headquarters space.
Amgen's planned 418,000 sq ft is supported by the reopened retained Area Development article, not the reopened company or JobsOhio primary sources. No completed opening is claimed for the expansion.
Lilly's Lebanon genetic-medicine opening and CSL's Kankakee groundbreaking have no floor-area quantities in the cited sources. Planned operating dates are not treated as completed openings.
Original company and retained source IDs are preserved. Baseline and research layers remain separate in evidenceStatus; source verification does not promote research records into the baseline census.

Older SHINE construction and Lilly Wisconsin acquisition events, out-of-region parent events, approvals, financing, workforce changes and operator transfers are not treated as 2025-2026 net physical demand. No aggregate market figures or census counts are generated.

seattle.geography: Core Seattle metropolitan area limited to King, Snohomish and Pierce counties. No Washington statewide substitution. The bounding box is calculated from the Census county geometries, in WGS84 longitude and latitude.
seattle.decisionRead: Immunome signed an additional Bothell office lease. Sana paused Bothell manufacturing build-out and pursued potential Seattle/Bothell subleases. These documented actions show committed office space alongside planned space release, not market-wide net absorption.
reviewGaps: Additional 2025-2026 local footprint actions were not established from the reviewed retained evidence. Financing, approvals, program changes, workforce reductions and unchanged site presence were not used as space-demand signals.

Sana's filing supports a suspended Bothell build-out and pursuit of potential subleases, not a completed sublease, lease termination or site closure. The amount of space offered is not established and is omitted.

Kestra's retained filing reports a lease expansion commencing April 1, 2025. A supplementary primary annual filing identifies Kirkland premises but does not explicitly tie the amendment to a named local address. The action is omitted rather than allocating an unnamed lease change locally.

No Seattle-specific internal JLL source was present in the retained evidence bundle. Supplied research and analyst assumptions were not promoted to primary physical facts; the selected company IDs retain their baseline identity.

The retained evidence does not establish a qualifying recent footprint action in Everett or Pierce County. Redmond's retained J.POD opening predates the requested period; Spokane and Vancouver, Washington are outside this region. No statewide or global parent action was substituted.

boulder.geography: Core: Boulder County, Colorado. Extension: contiguous Front Range municipalities only when a company has a qualifying physical site. This is not a Colorado statewide population or a legal regional polygon. Bounding envelope spans the core and named extension municipalities.
boulder.decisionRead: Known actions show a signed Boulder peptide-lab lease and continuing oligonucleotide construction in Frederick. SomaLogic's Boulder operation changed ownership; that transaction does not establish added space. Opening and net-absorption conclusions remain unproven.
reviewGaps: Retained evidence does not support six distinct 2025 or 2026 physical-space actions. Financing, clinical milestones, job postings, and analyst assumptions were not used as footprint demand.
No accessible Boulder-specific internal JLL evidence was identified. Basel internal extracts concern another region and were not used.
The Frederick and SomaLogic records remain reported research observations, not additions to the baseline census. Frederick is shown as a separately labeled Northern Front Range research location.
CordenPharma's source confirms a completed building and signed lease, but does not establish lab opening, occupancy commencement, or net local absorption.

Agilent's retained 2023 article forecast completion in 2026. Its May 2026 company interview targets train operations in 2027; later completion status and current expansion square footage remain unestablished.

Biodesix and Mesa filings establish existing local space, not an in-period local footprint action. Cerapedics' retained expansion announcement is from 2023, without a supported 2025 or 2026 opening milestone.

AGC's planned Colorado closures appear in a separate retained watchlist note, but AGC has no company or source identity in the supplied Boulder evidence. No closure card or assumed vacated area was added.
The SomaLogic acquisition is a completed operator change tied to a readable Boulder site source. It does not demonstrate expansion, relocation, lease termination, or net new demand.

uk.geography: United Kingdom national overview with separately coded subclusters. It does not treat Greater London as a proxy for the country. Bbox from the ONS UK ITL1 boundary reference.
uk.decisionRead: Known actions show manufacturing and laboratory additions at Billingham and Harwell, alongside Autolus lease retention in White City and planned fit-out at Stevenage. These are distinct physical actions, not evidence of nationwide net absorption or a market forecast.
reviewGaps: The retained UK records do not support six distinct 2025-2026 physical-space actions. Current addresses, financing, clinical approvals and assumed demand were not used to fill remaining cards.
No UK-specific internal JLL action source was retained in the supplied evidence file. No private brochure or supplied PDF aggregate figure was used.
The retained GSK Ware investment URL is dated 27 July 2016, not 2025-2026, so it was excluded.
AstraZeneca's retained Maryland investment and Kendall Square opening are US site actions, not evidence of UK footprint change, and were excluded.

The retained FUJIFILM Billingham facility URL uk:s127 was inaccessible and carried no readable action fact. A new company announcement was added under a separate source ID; uk:s127 was not presented as newly reverified.
FUJIFILM's February 2026 announcement confirms the opening event but gives a planned H1 2026 manufacturing operating start. Later operational completion was not verified in this bounded review.
Autolus's Nucleus main works were scheduled for March 2026 under a 2024 agreement. The reopened filing does not confirm completion, and this card does not imply additional leased area.
Moderna's retained project article reports development area rather than verified company-occupied area. No area figure or campus acreage was converted into tenant demand.

No supported 2025-2026 UK site closure, new sublease or M&A operator-change action was identified in the retained events. Autolus's older Enfield subleases and non-UK laboratory decommissioning were not recast as current UK contraction.
